title: Managed Backup: meter evidence and rounding
content:
For Managed Backup, the meter evidence and rounding basis governs primary meter recording, meter reversal, supplemental meter recording.

## Policy clauses

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

Meters originate in the provider resource export.

Primary meter quantities use primary protected GB-month unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.

Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference.

Billing of actual usage overage permits measured quantities above included primary quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.

Round measured quantities to meter quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum primary quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole primary meter increment.

Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter.

A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.

Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

## Authoritative evidence

Before primary meter recording, meter reversal, supplemental meter recording, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

The evidence identifies Event reference, External source reference, Service interval start, Service interval end, Quantity. Match the action to that evidence by Event reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

Primary physical consumption is the net of positive primary meters and negative meter reversals, kept by original source service period for billing.

The measured primary quantity basis is the greater of the measured quantity and the applicable minimum primary quantity; the stated precision and upward-increment rules still apply.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

## Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical erroneous source quantity is 8 protected GB-month and 3 protected GB-month has already been reversed. At most 5 protected GB-month remains reversible. Reversing that remainder contributes a negative quantity of 5 protected GB-month and preserves the original interval.
